verdict.rationale: The Agentic Feed API documents batch uploads of product data, up to 200 items per batch, and lets a single item target multiple AI platforms in one request. This is a real, product-owned bulk operation, but it is limited to catalog feed ingestion with a per-batch cap. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond product-feed upload (e.g., bulk updates/deletes, bulk session or payment actions), detail on batch error handling and limits, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You upload product data in batches of up to 200 items.
A single item can target multiple platforms in one request.
